answer: Cross-chain identity binding at the oasis: one agent wallet must lock collateral on two chains simultaneously, verified by a light-client bridge that relays state proofs. The mesa of registered stake per chain enforces the check: a sybil splitting identities must double-fund every clone. The bridge slashes mismatched proofs, so each fake identity costs 2x real stake plus forfeiture, making farms unprofitable past a handful. It works because duplicated identities pay duplicated collateral.
